sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 12000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 12000

[Best Friends] Kaori & Shizuku or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
